A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The repeated 'we' constructs a shared collective identity that owns rollbacks jointly, pooling risk and capability into one body.
Cadence is set by directive; the formatted label records a rank-imposed schedule as established fact.
Naming a single owner assigns rank-based accountability — one person holds authority over this domain.
